hook: A rocky planet just revealed its scorching heat from across the galaxy.

sections.voiceover: A rocky planet just revealed its scorching heat from across the galaxy.
sections.visual_cue: Close up of a glowing rocky exoplanet in deep space.
b_roll: NASA artist concept of a rocky exoplanet

sections.voiceover: In 2019, the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite spotted TOI-2431b. How hot does a rocky planet get when it circles that close?
sections.visual_cue: Animation showing a planet orbiting a star quickly.

sections.voiceover: The Hubble Space Telescope just captured the planet's secondary eclipse for the first time.
b_roll: Hubble Space Telescope public domain image

sections.voiceover: The Leiden Observatory combined Hubble and TESS data to confirm this intense 2524 K temperature.
sections.visual_cue: Thermal map of an exoplanet showing high temperatures.
b_roll: NASA artistic representation of molten planet

sections.voiceover: The Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite continues to track this rocky world discovered in 2019.
sections.visual_cue: Wide shot of a star system drifting into darkness.
